title: Block Crust Adventure
summary: A tactile Flutter arcade that fuses voxel worlds with haptic puzzles, shipped to iOS, Android, and web in one codebase.
outcomes: Top 5 launch on Google Play Indie corner

body.raw:
import { Gallery } from "@/components/mdx/mdx-components";

## Gameplay loops

- Built responsive voxel renderer with custom shaders, 120hz animation loops, and battery-aware performance budgets.
- Designed puzzle difficulty curves using telemetry-driven scoring and ML-based hint generation.
- Implemented cross-device save slots with Firebase listeners and offline-first persistence.

## Motion & polish

<Gallery images={[
  { src: "/images/projects/block-crust-battle.webp", alt: "Boss battle animation" },
  { src: "/images/projects/block-crust-builder.webp", alt: "Level builder UI" }
]} />

- Authored cinematic haptics with Core Haptics + custom Android vibration patterns.
- Composed 150+ micro-interactions with Rive state machines and spring physics.
- Added tactile audio cues with procedural synthesis for accessible gameplay.
